rank_selection: For each rank choose B1 alpha minimizing 5-fold TRAIN validation macro-MAE; choose rank with minimum B1 score, tie lower rank. B2 scores cannot select rank. Both modes share selected rank.
alpha_selection: At shared rank, each mode independently chooses alpha minimizing its own 5-fold TRAIN validation macro-MAE; tie smaller alpha.
oof: At selected shared rank and each mode's locked alpha, concatenate all five held-out TRAIN predictions; folds and feature fits are identical to selection stage. Reused folds mean estimates are selection-conditioned, not external validation.

gate.go: B2 macro-MAE improvement >= 0.002 original VAD units; at least 4 of 5 paired folds improve; no dimension MAE worsens by > 0.005; no dimension CCC drops by > 0.02; each B2/B1 prediction standard-deviation ratio >= 0.5; all outputs finite

no_rescue: No candidate expansion, DEV tuning, alternative fold split, or rerun based on result.
